name: Iraira Yoku Bou 3 - Shiranui Hen -
original_name: いらいら欲棒３ -不知火編-
source:
A new action game to manipulate mouse and open scenes with big breasted kunoichi Mai Shiranui from famous fighting series Fatal Fury.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一款使用鼠标操作的全新动作游戏，通关后可解锁以知名格斗游戏系列《饿狼传说》中的巨乳女忍者不知火舞为主角的场景。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
